appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Risk Index of Hazard H in US States'.
Vertical color legend labeled 'High' at top (100) and 'Low' at bottom (0); scale runs from pale yellow (top) through orange to dark maroon (bottom).
States WA, ID, WY, KS, OK, and NM are filled with the darkest maroon color, matching the bottom of the legend (Low / 0).
States RI, DE, MA, and NJ are filled with pale yellow, matching the top of the legend (High / 100).
State TX is filled with pale yellow (High / 100).
